description: Send an outbound message through the bot API to a specified phone number. Supports text and media messages. Requires a valid API key.

apiKey.description: Bot API key with 'nrn_' prefix for authentication

channelId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of a specific WhatsApp channel to send from. Uses the bot's primary channel if omitted.

mediaUrl.description: Public URL of the media file to attach (required for non-text message types)

message.description: The message text to send to the recipient

messageType.description: Type of message to send: 'text', 'image', 'video', 'audio', or 'document' (default: 'text')

sendAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time for scheduled delivery (e.g., '2025-12-31T10:00:00Z'). Message sends immediately if omitted.

name: neuron_bot_api_send
title: Bot API Send
